text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD-INC-8792 — metrics_silence + log-ingest-lag > 30m. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metrics-silence

incident-bot: Autopage: page sent to SRE oncall. Acknowledge required.

sre-oncall-alex: acked. I'm on it. Any known customer impact?

ci-cust-ops: customers 'acme' and 'orbit' reporting missing telemetry and degraded dashboards. They're asking for ETA.

maria-engsre: investigating. Prometheus shows kafka_consumer_lag for log-ingest around 120k; backpressure in the pipeline.

```
sum(kafka_consumer_lag{consumer=\"log-ingest\"})
=> 123450
```

maria-engsre: also seeing node-exporter + app-exporter targets down in ca-central-1; prometheus scrape_count falling.

tony-sre: if this isn't resolved in 10m escalate per runbook. @net-team please check for recent ACLs or peering changes affecting ca-central-1.

incident-bot: PD update: page created PD-2026-8792, unacked -> acked by sre-oncall-alex (1768854332).

sre-oncall-alex: scaling log-ingest consumers from 3 -> 6 to catch up: `kubectl scale deployment/log-ingest-consumer --replicas=6 -n prod`

maria-engsre: starting rolling restart of log-ingest-consumer in prod-retail: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/log-ingest-consumer -n prod-retail`

```
2026-03-12T14:21:03 ERROR java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: GC overhead limit exceeded
2026-03-12T14:21:04 INFO restarting pod log-ingest-consumer-5f6d7
```

maria-engsre: new pods are up, lag dropped from 123k -> ~40k and decreasing.

maria-engsre: ran prom target check: `up{job=\"prom-scrape-proxy\",region=\"ca-central-1\"}` returned 0/10. after restarting scrape-proxy we see 9/10. One exporter still flapping.

net-team: not aware of intentional ACL changes. We see a transient routing flap to ca-central-1 in the peering fabric around 14:18 UTC — correlates with the start of the incident. Engineers are investigating with cloud provider.

ci-cust-ops: customers notified of active mitigation. They'll be watching for restored telemetry.

sre-oncall-alex: starting backlog backfill but will limit parallelism to avoid saturating CPU: `./bin/backfill --topic=logs --from=2026-03-12T12:00Z --parallel=8`

maria-engsre: initiating backfill; monitoring throughput and consumer lag. If CPU climbs >85% we throttle.

tony-sre: good call. Note for postmortem: chain = network flap -> scrape proxies momentarily unavailable -> consumers hit OOM on restart -> autoscale gated by PDB/HPA constraints -> backlog buildup.

maria-engsre: after backfill and scale, current lag ~4k. Prom targets stable ~12m. Exporter that was flapping is on a degraded host — we've moved it to a healthy node.

sre-oncall-alex: mitigated for now. Will keep the alert open for 10 more minutes of stability then close. Filing postmortem and tagging eng-sre. :thumbsup:

maria-engsre: creating a follow-up ticket to remove tight PDB coupling for log-ingest and add OOM guard (memory request/limits tuning + oom_score_adj).

tony-sre: thanks everyone. If it re-opens escalate to SRE lead.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated — last status: log-ingest lag 4k, prometheus targets healthy. PD incident will be closed if no regression. Please file postmortem: https://redwood/incidents/new
